# Agent Hatchers

> An Australian, founder-led AI studio. We install Hermes — a client's own AI platform where a team of AI agents does real work for their business: sales follow-up, document generation, invoice processing, website updates and more. Clients talk to their agents in Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Hermes directly. Simple pricing: a one-off installation fee, a monthly subscription (hosting, updates, support), and agents at set prices. AI usage is billed at cost through OpenRouter — clients pay per token used, not per seat, and can swap the underlying AI model with one click.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://agenthatchers.com/): The authoritative entry point — what Hermes is, the interactive agent demo, how installation works, and how to book.
- [Meet the agents](https://agenthatchers.com/#demo): Interactive demo of the agent model — one agent per job (sales, documents, invoices, website), each in its own separate conversation, with one-click model swapping.
- [How it works](https://agenthatchers.com/#how): Three steps — we install Hermes and connect it to the client's existing tools; the client picks agents (ready-made at set prices, custom-built, or self-built in plain English); the agents start working.
- [Why Hermes](https://agenthatchers.com/#why): The four-part argument — pay-per-token pricing via OpenRouter instead of fixed subscriptions; hundreds of pre-installed skills so output sounds like the client, not a chatbot; one-click model swapping with no vendor lock-in; complete separation between agents.
- [Agent library](https://agenthatchers.com/#agents): Ready-made agents at set prices (Sales, Document, Invoice, Support, Website), custom agents quoted up front, and unlimited self-built agents included with every installation.
- [Pricing](https://agenthatchers.com/#pricing): One-off installation fee, monthly subscription covering hosting/updates/support, set price per agent, and AI usage billed at cost.

## Company
- [About Agent Hatchers](https://agenthatchers.com/#trust): Founder-led — Hyein Yu (Founder, Head of Engineering) architects every installation; Noah Webb (Co-founder, CEO) runs every client relationship. Australian team, same-timezone delivery.
- [FAQ](https://agenthatchers.com/#faq): Authoritative answers on what Hermes is, what an agent is, pricing, why not just use ChatGPT, building your own agents, and support.
- [Book a call](https://calendly.com/noah-automationbuilders/30min): 30-minute call — a live Hermes demo, a fit assessment, and a price on the spot.
